handoff.salientSummary: Implemented ConfigMap generator for OpenCompass configuration in k8s/configmap package. Generates valid MMEngine Python config files with model config (OpenAI/Anthropic/DashScope), dataset config, and inferencer settings. ConfigMap created with correct labels matching Job (app=llm-eval, eval-id, model, dataset).
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created ConfigMap generator package (internal/k8s/configmap/generator.go) with OpenCompassConfigGenerator struct that generates MMEngine Python config files. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and DashScope model configurations with proper API key environment variable references. Generates config with model config, dataset config, and inferencer settings. Includes Labels() function usage for correct labeling (app=llm-eval, eval-id, model, dataset). ConfigMap data field contains 'config.py' key. Created comprehensive test suite with 22 test cases validating config generation, syntax validation, and model-specific settings.
